title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #1

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which action follows the Jain teaching of gentleness? (1 mark)
   A. Throwing stones
   B. Breaking eggs
   C. Chasing animals
   D. Not stepping on ants or hurting animals for fun

2. In which year did Kenya gain internal self-government? (1 mark)
   A. 1980
   B. 1963
   C. 1950
   D. 2010

3. You find Ksh 100 on the school field. What shows integrity? (1 mark)
   A. Spend it on sweets
   B. Give it away
   C. Keep it quietly
   D. Give it to the teacher so it can be returned

4. Which is a good food safety rule? (1 mark)
   A. Eat with dirty hands
   B. Leave food in the sun
   C. Wash hands before eating
   D. Share used cups

5. A family keeps a Tulsi plant at home. What is a good daily habit for them? (1 mark)
   A. Water it every morning
   B. Ignore it
   C. Cut it down
   D. Burn it

6. Which is a safety rule for festivals? (1 mark)
   A. Run in the temple
   B. Ask an adult to light lamps
   C. Play with fire
   D. Eat from the ground

7. How can you show a Mandir in a drawing? (1 mark)
   A. A river
   B. A rectangle hall with a pointed spire
   C. A zigzag line
   D. A circle only

8. Whose hymns are also in Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji? (1 mark)
   A. Valmiki and Sigala
   B. Dasharatha and Ram
   C. Bhagat Kabir Ji and Bhagat Ravidas Ji
   D. Prahlad and Siddhartha

9. What does sakha mean in the prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Mother
   B. Wealth
   C. Friend
   D. God

10. Which planet is closest to the Sun? (1 mark)
   A. Mars
   B. Mercury
   C. Saturn
   D. Venus

11. What does Asteya include besides not stealing things? (1 mark)
   A. Not smiling
   B. Not using another's time or ideas without asking
   C. Not walking
   D. Not eating

12. Which element is called Agni? (1 mark)
   A. Water
   B. Fire
   C. Air
   D. Space

13. What does Purushartha mean? (1 mark)
   A. The goals of life
   B. A river
   C. A prayer
   D. A festival

14. Where did Prince Siddhartha sit under the Bodhi tree? (1 mark)
   A. Amritsar
   B. Lumbini
   C. Bodh Gaya
   D. Nairobi

15. Which is a sign of integrity? (1 mark)
   A. Telling lies
   B. Keeping your promises
   C. Taking a friend's pen
   D. Cheating in a test

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. What does Dainik Prarthana mean? (2 marks)

17. Who was Sri Guru Ram Das Ji's teacher and predecessor? (2 marks)

18. What does yoga mean? (2 marks)

19. Suggest four activities for celebrating International Yoga Day in school. (4 marks)

20. Why should children do Bhastrika and Kapaal Bhaati gently? (2 marks)

21. Choose one teaching from an Enlightened Being and say how you can follow it at school. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Not stepping on ants or hurting animals for fun
   Gentleness to living things is central.

2. B — 1963
   On 1 June 1963.

3. D — Give it to the teacher so it can be returned
   A lost note belongs to its owner.

4. C — Wash hands before eating
   Hygiene is important.

5. A — Water it every morning
   Watering the Tulsi is part of caring for it.

6. B — Ask an adult to light lamps
   Adults should handle flames.

7. B — A rectangle hall with a pointed spire
   A hall with a spire is a simple model.

8. C — Bhagat Kabir Ji and Bhagat Ravidas Ji
   It includes holy men of other traditions.

9. C — Friend
   Sakha means friend.

10. B — Mercury
   Mercury is nearest to the Sun.

11. B — Not using another's time or ideas without asking
   It includes respecting others' things and ideas.

12. B — Fire
   Agni means fire, heat and light.

13. A — The goals of life
   Purushartha means the goals of a person's life.

14. C — Bodh Gaya
   He became the Buddha at Bodh Gaya.

15. B — Keeping your promises
   Keeping promises shows honesty.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Daily prayers.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for daily and 1 mark for prayers.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: Guru Amar Das Ji, the third Guru.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the name and 1 mark for third Guru.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: To join or unite the body, breath and mind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for join, 1 mark for the three things.

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: Doing yoga together, taking photos or videos, making a chart of asanas, making a guidance video with an adult (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: They are active breathing exercises, so children need a teacher and must stop when tired.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Any sensible answer, for example Ahimsa: I will not bully or hurt classmates, and I will care for plants.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the being, 1 mark for the teaching, 1 mark for a clear action.
